prompt: Objective: set the nightly price of new cabins at a national park campground. What you've learned: campers would pay about $20 more than for a tent site. Latest finding: each cabin takes the space of two tent sites. What is the best next step?

options.text: Compare the cabin with the two tent sites it replaces
options.feedback: Right. A cabin takes two tent sites' space, so it must earn more than both.

options.text: Survey campers again on what they would pay
Estimate the cost of building the cabins
options.feedback: Secondary: the bigger issue is the tent sites each cabin displaces.

options.text: Calculate revenue at $20 above a tent site
options.feedback: That misses the finding: a cabin replaces two tent sites, so $20 more than one site may earn less than two.

explanation: Each cabin displaces two tent sites, so its price must beat what those two sites earn.
